pages.title: About Institution - Siddaganga Institute of Technology
pages.text: A Campus That Inspires A dynamic blend of academics, innovation, and cultural vibrancy—where every student finds their path Cutting-Edge Infrastructure Equipped with smart classrooms, high-tech labs, and world-class facilities designed for the engineers of tomorrow Lush Green Campus Experience learning amid serene greenery and eco-conscious surroundings at SIT’s award-winning campus Siddaganga Institute of Technology (SIT), Tumakuru, established in 1963, is an autonomous institution affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi. It is one of the 122 institutions run by the Sree Siddaganga Education Society, founded by His Holiness Padma Bhushana, Karnataka Ratna Dr. Sree Sree Sivakumara Swamiji, who served society selflessly for 111 years. Today, the institute thrives under the guidance of His Holiness Sree Sree Siddalinga Swamigalu. Academic Excellence: SIT offers 13 undergraduate and 6 postgraduate programs, with 16 VTU-recognized research programs. National Rankings & Accolades: SIT consistently ranks among the top 100 engineering colleges in NIRF rankings and is accredited with NAAC A++ grade Today, SIT is proud to have Students 4600 + Departments 17 Dr. Sree Sree Sivakumara Swamigalu Founder Our Heritage Established in 1963 by His Holiness Dr. Sree Sree Sivakumara Swamiji under the aegis of Sree Siddaganga Education Society(SSES). pages.title: Controller of Examinations - Siddaganga Institute of Technology
pages.text: Controller of Examinations Office of the Controller of Examinations Siddaganga Institute of Technology (SIT), established in the year 1963 by Sree Siddaganga Education Society, is now affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University, Belagavi. SIT has received the status of academic autonomy during the academic year 2007–2008. This facilitates SIT to frame its own syllabus for all the programmes and devise an appropriate assessment mechanism. The Examination section of SIT has been restructured to carry out all the examination activities and named as Office of the Controller of Examinations (CoE) in the academic year 2007–2008. What CoE Does Conducts and oversees all Academic examinations Publishes results and maintains academic records Manages test and examination timetables and graduation records Ensures examination integrity and fairness Examination Guidelines Malpractice Policy Grading Table Examination Team Dr. S V Dinesh Principal Chief Controller of Examinations Dr. A S Poornima Professor, CSE Controller of Examinations Dr. C Banuprakash Asst. pages.title: Internal Quality Assurance Cell - Siddaganga Institute of Technology
pages.text: Internal Quality Assurance Cell(IQAC) Core Objectives System Development To develop a system for conscious, consistent and catalytic action to improve the academic and administrative performance of the Institution thereby enhance the brand image of the institute. Quality Enhancement To promote measures for institutional functioning towards quality enhancement through internalization of quality culture and institutionalization of best practices. Our Strategies IQAC shall evolve mechanisms and procedures for: Performance Excellence Ensuring timely, efficient and progressive performance of academic, administrative and financial tasks Program Quality The relevance and quality of academic and research programmes Modern Methods Optimization and integration of modern methods of teaching and learning Evaluation Credibility The credibility of evaluation procedures Support Structure Ensuring the adequacy, maintenance and proper allocation of support structure and services Key Functions 1. Quality Benchmarks Development and application of quality benchmarks/parameters for various academic and administrative activities of the institution 2. Learner-Centric Environment Facilitating the creation of a learner-centric environment conducive to quality education and faculty maturation 3. Feedback Mechanism Arrangement for feedback response from students, parents and other stakeholders on quality-related institutional processes 4. Information Dissemination Dissemination of information on various quality parameters of higher education 5. Workshops & Seminars Organization of inter and intra institutional workshops, seminars on quality related themes and promotion of quality circles 6. Documentation Documentation of the various programmes/activities leading to quality improvement 7. Quality Coordination Acting as a nodal agency of the Institution for coordinating quality-related activities, including adoption and dissemination of best practices 8. pages.title: Campus - Siddaganga Institute of Technology
pages.text: Experience Life at SIT Our Campus Nestled within a thriving academic hub, SIT’s campus strikes a perfect balance between tradition and modernity. Designed to inspire learning and innovation, the campus features smart classrooms, well-equipped labs, and collaborative spaces that encourage intellectual growth. Lush greenery, dedicated recreation zones, and thoughtfully planned infrastructure create a vibrant and welcoming environment. From tech-driven learning hubs to student-led clubs and cultural arenas, SIT fosters a holistic campus experience where ideas flourish and community thrives. Campus Facilities The campus provides essential facilities to support students’ daily needs and ensure a comfortable environment. These services offer convenient access to banking, postal, and basic amenities within the campus Co-operative Society Post Office Health Center Refreshment Zone Printing & Photocopy Center Sports At Siddaganga Institute of Technology, we believe in nurturing both the mind and body. Our campus boasts state-of-the-art sports and recreational amenities designed to promote fitness, teamwork, and overall well-being. Know More Yoga Yoga is an essential part of campus life, helping students maintain physical fitness and mental well-being. Regular sessions guided by experts encourage focus, balance, and a healthy lifestyle in a peaceful campus environment. Gymnasium The campus gym provides modern fitness equipment and a motivating environment for students to maintain strength, endurance, and overall well-being. It supports a healthy and active lifestyle alongside academic pursuits. Clubs At Siddaganga Institute of Technology, student life extends far beyond the classroom. With over 50 active student clubs across technical, cultural, literary, and social domains, SIT offers every student the chance to explore their passions, develop leadership skills, and create lifelong friendships. Whether you’re a performer, innovator, leader, or changemaker, SIT provides the perfect platform to explore your potential and shape your future — together with peers who share your drive. Know More Hostels The campus has 5 hostel blocks (3 for boys and 2 for girls) with vegetarian food available. Facilities include 24/7 hot water via heat pump, 1 Gbps Wi-Fi, vegetarian mess, study rooms, indoor sports facilities in the girls’ block, common recreation areas, and spacious double and triple sharing accommodation. Know More NCC The National Cadet Corps (NCC) at SIT focuses on developing discipline, leadership, and a sense of national pride among students. Cadets undergo structured training that includes drills, physical fitness sessions, and participation in various military and adventure camps. Key activities include: Drill Training & Military Camps Weapon Training & Map Reading Sessions Social Service & Awareness Rallies Participation in National Camps (Trekking, RDC, TSC) NCC The National Cadet Corps (NCC) at SIT focuses on developing discipline, leadership, and a sense of national pride among students. Cadets undergo structured training that includes drills, physical fitness sessions, and participation in various military and adventure camps. Key activities include: Drill Training & Military Camps Weapon Training & Map Reading Sessions Social Service & Awareness Rallies Participation in National Camps (Trekking, RDC, TSC) Know More NSS The National Service Scheme (NSS) at SIT encourages students to actively engage in community service and nation-building initiatives. Through various outreach programs, awareness drives, and environmental activities, NSS helps students develop social responsibility, leadership qualities, and a commitment to serving society.Key activities include: Blood Donation Camps: Organized in partnership with health institutions to promote life-saving awareness. Swachh Bharat & Tree Plantation Drives: Commitment to a cleaner and greener society. Rural Outreach & Awareness Programs: Health, hygiene, and education campaigns for nearby communities. pages.text: National Cadet Corps (NCC) National Cadet Corps 4 Karnataka Battalion NCC · Karnataka-Goa Directorate · Army Wing “Unity and Discipline” — Shaping Leaders, Serving the Nation Unit Details Unit Name 4 Karnataka Battalion NCC Directorate Karnataka-Goa Directorate Type Army Wing Institution SIT, Tumakuru About The National Cadet Corps (NCC) is India’s premier youth development organisation functioning under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. It provides a platform for students to imbibe the values of discipline, leadership, character and national integration through structured military training, social service, and adventure activities. At Siddaganga Institute of Technology, Tumakuru, the NCC unit is an integral part of campus life. Our cadets represent the spirit of service and dedication, participating in training programmes, national events, and community initiatives throughout the academic year. Vision, Mission & Motto Vision To develop responsible, disciplined, and patriotic young citizens who contribute positively to the nation and society. Mission To build character, leadership, and a spirit of selfless service among students through NCC training, camps, and activities. Motto “Unity and Discipline” The guiding principles of every NCC cadet at SIT Tumakuru. NCC Officer / Leadership The National Cadet Corps unit of Siddaganga Institute of Technology, Tumakuru, has been privileged to witness a distinguished transition of leadership — one that reflects the corps’ enduring values of duty, discipline, and continuity of service. Lieutenant (Dr.) Prasanna D R, having rendered commendable service to the unit, formally entrusted the responsibilities of command to CTO Dr. Vineeth Kumar T V. This handover, conducted with seamless professionalism, stands as a testament to the institutional integrity and cooperative spirit that define the NCC at SIT Tumkur. CTO Dr. Vineeth Kumar T V assumed charge of the unit on 18th September 2025 with dedication and a resolute sense of purpose. Notwithstanding his relatively recent association with the NCC fraternity, he has discharged his responsibilities with the commitment and sincerity befitting the highest traditions of the Corps. His ability to harmonise the demands of academic obligations with the rigours of NCC administration reflects both his professional calibre and his personal devotion to the institution. His accessibility to cadets, his empathetic approach to their concerns, and his readiness to render guidance always have established him as a mentor of considerable repute within the unit. The cadets under his charge have found in him not merely an officer, but a dependable guide and a source of steady inspiration. Under the stewardship of CTO Dr. Vineeth Kumar T V, the NCC unit of Siddaganga Institute of Technology, Tumakuru, continues to progress with renewed vigour, fortified discipline, and an abiding commitment to the ideals upon which the National Cadet Corps was founded. Dr. Vineeth Kumar T V CTO · Caretaker NCC Officer Dept: Mechanical Engineering Email: [email omitted] Message from the Officer “Our goal is to nurture disciplined, confident, and socially responsible young leaders. pages.text: National Service Scheme National Service Scheme Government of India · Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports · Est. 1969 “Not Me, But You” — Building a Stronger, More Inclusive Society About National Service Scheme The National Service Scheme (NSS) is a Government of India–sponsored public service program launched in 1969, with the primary objective of developing the personality and character of students through voluntary community service. NSS provides students with opportunities to engage in meaningful social work such as community development, health and hygiene awareness, environmental protection, social justice initiatives, and national integration programs. Through regular activities and special camps, students gain hands-on experience in addressing real-world issues while fostering empathy, leadership, discipline, and teamwork. The scheme aims to create socially responsible citizens who are sensitive to societal problems and committed to contributing positively to the nation. “Not Me, But You” The guiding philosophy of NSS — placing the needs of society and community above individual ambitions. By bridging the gap between academic learning and social realities, NSS plays a vital role in shaping youth into confident, service-oriented, and responsible individuals. NSS at SIT Tumakuru The National Service Scheme (NSS) at Siddaganga Institute of Technology is a vibrant platform that inspires students to serve society with commitment, compassion, and a strong sense of national responsibility. Guided by the core philosophy of selfless service, NSS at SIT plays a vital role in shaping socially aware and responsible citizens. Our NSS unit actively engages students in a wide range of community-oriented and nation-building activities. NSS volunteers at SIT develop leadership qualities, teamwork, discipline, and empathy. The unit serves as a bridge between the institute and society, enabling students to learn beyond textbooks and contribute meaningfully to the nation. NSS at SIT stands as a symbol of youth energy, social commitment, and the spirit of service — working together to build a healthier, stronger, and more inclusive society. NSS at SIT is not just a platform for community service, but a movement that nurtures socially responsible and committed individuals. Guided by the motto “Not Me, But You”, our volunteers actively engage in various outreach programs including rural development, environmental sustainability, health awareness, blood donation camps, cleanliness drives, and social empowerment initiatives. We strive to create a positive impact on society while shaping responsible citizens.” Activity Areas Health & Hygiene Awareness camps, donation drives, cancer prevention Environment Park cleanliness, plantation, eco-awareness Civic Education Constitution Day, governance & rights awareness Patriotic Events Tiranga Yatra, national celebrations Youth Empowerment Career guidance, education awareness Safety Awareness Snake awareness, road safety, social programs Social Harmony Cultural events, community integration Anti-Addiction Nasha Mukth Bharath Abhiyan campaigns Join NSS NSS enrollment is open at the beginning of each academic year. pages.title: Architecture - Siddaganga Institute of Technology
pages.text: Department of Architecture Admissions Overview Established in 1992, the School of Architecture at Siddaganga Institute of Technology is committed to cultivating creative, socially responsible, and environmentally conscious architects. The five-year B.Arch program emphasizes a studio-based, hands-on approach to learning, integrating design, technology, and sustainability. Supported by experienced faculty and modern infrastructure, students engage in live projects, workshops, internships, and community-focused design initiatives. With access to digital fabrication labs, construction yards, and interdisciplinary learning, the school nurtures critical thinking and innovation. SOA-SIT continues to evolve as a leading institution, empowering students to shape resilient, inclusive, and contextually responsive built environments Program Details Duration: 5 Years The School of Architecture at Siddaganga Institute of Technology offers a Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch) program with an annual intake of 40 students. This five-year undergraduate program is approved by the Council of Architecture (COA) and affiliated with VTU, Belagavi. The department is also a recognized VTU Research Centre for Ph.D. in Architecture, providing opportunities for advanced research in areas such as sustainable design, vernacular architecture, and urban studies. Vision & Mission Vision To establish as a pioneer institute in planning and design of built environment through excellence in teaching, research, consultancy and design innovation. Mission M1: To create conducive academic ambience that nurtures aesthetic attitude, technical confidence, and critical thinking among students. M2: To develop research and design innovation skills in students to address various societal needs. M3: To inculcate professional ethics based on values and entrepreneurial skills among students. Infrastructure & Facilities The Department of Architecture is equipped with modern facilities: Design studios, High-tech computer lab Climatology lab Art lab Model making lab Material Museum Construction Yard Permanent exhibition Faculty The department has a highly qualified and experienced faculty with expertise in areas such as urban design, landscape architecture, digital architecture, sustainable design, and more. Faculty members actively engage in research and collaborate with industry professionals and organizations to stay updated with emerging trends and advancements in the field of architecture. The curriculum emphasizes studio-based learning, creativity, and technical competence, preparing students for professional careers in architecture and the built environment. Syllabus 1st Year (Sem I & II) 2nd Year (Sem III & IV) 3rd Year (Sem V & VI) 4th Year (Sem VII & VIII) 5th Year (Sem IX & X) Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) - UG Graduates from school of Architecture will achieve the following Program Educational Objectives within few years of graduation : Graduates will showcase capabilities for competent practice of Architecture and enhance career by pursuing higher education Graduates will exhibit strong design skills to solve complex real-time problems through high technical skills and strong communication along with the knowledge of various domains of architecture including landscape, architectural conservation, interior design, energy conscious architecture, urban design and planning, construction project management, alternative building techniques, building information modeling and digital architecture Graduates will demonstrate professionalism, ethical conduct, societal concerns, effective team work and adapt to dynamic global and local needs engaging in lifelong learning. Program Outcomes (POs) - UG Graduates will be able to: Architectural Knowledge : Apply the knowledge of design principles, building systems & technologies, humanities and environmental aspects in design, planning and construction. Problem Analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyse various scales of architectural projects to arrive at tangible conclusions. Design/ Development of solutions: Design solutions to integrate interdisciplinary approach for contextual issues pertaining to built-environment. Conduct investigations of complex problems: Use research-based knowledge and methodologies including context analysis, case studies, project requirements and synthesis of the information to provide context sensitive solutions. Modern tool usage: Identify, select and apply the appropriate tools, techniques and resources to predict, design and simulate qualitative and quantitative outcomes with an understanding of its limitations. The Architect and Society: Apply reasoning to address socio-cultural, legal and safety aspects relevant to the professional practice and social responsibility. Environment and Sustainability: Understand the importance of the architectural design solutions in environmental and social contexts to demonstrate the need for sustainable built environment. Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, responsibilities and norms of Architectural profession. Individual and teamwork: Function effectively as an individual as well as a team member or a leader in diverse interdisciplinary settings. Communication: Comprehend and effectively communicate issues related to architecture, community and society at large through documentation, graphical and verbal presentations. Project management and Finance: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of professional and management principles to apply to individual work, as a team member and as a leader, to manage projects in multidisciplinary environments. Life-Long learning : Recognize the need for, have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and lifelong learning in the changing domain of societal and technological advancement and adopt it in individual’s professional practice Program Specific Outcomes (PSOs) PSO1: Develop critical thinking to analyze, evaluate, synthesize and generate appropriate design solutions for varying scales and levels of complexity. PSO2: Explore possibilities and application of various building materials, construction techniques, building systems and services. PSO3: Draw inspiration from divergent architectural theories and history along with varied indigenous and vernacular settings. PSO4: Demonstrate effective communication skills to present architectural works and comprehend professional practice. pages.text: Biotechnology Admissions Overview The Department of Biotechnology was established in 2006 and oﬀers undergraduate program in B.E., postgraduate (M.Sc. Engineering by Research) and Doctoral (Ph.D.) under the Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Karnataka. The Department is recognized as a Research Centre in the year 2011. The Department is committed to produce competent and ethically responsible biotechnology professionals. Academic and research activities in the Department includes Bioinformatics, Molecular Biology, Fermentation Technology, Nanobiotechnology, Systems Biology, and Big Data Analytics. These thrust areas are supported by a team of six well-qualiﬁed and experienced faculty members whose expertise includes OMICS technologies, Biomolecular Simulations and Dynamics, Bioprocess Engineering, Nanomedicine, Applied Microbial Biotechnology, and Biopolymer Technology. The Department has received ﬁnancial support from KBITs, Government of Karnataka, and other funding organizations for infrastructure development, and academic initiatives. The Department has successfully oﬀered one-year Postgraduate Diploma in Bioinformatics and Big Data Analytics, supported by KBITs and the Government of Karnataka in the past. The Department has also executed several sponsored research projects by funding organizations such as KBITs, VGST, DBT, DST, SERB, and VTU. Department actively promotes Research and Innovations through industry collaboration and internships through MOUs and related activities. Program Details UG – B.E. in Biotechnology for duration of 4 years. The intake is 30 students M.Sc. Engineering in Research – A 3 year course with an intake according to VTU norms Ph.D – Intake through VTU enrolment The Department of Biotechnology has proactively aligned its curriculum with the principles of the National Education Policy 2020. The curriculum emphasizes multidisciplinary learning and skill-based education. Curriculum integrates emerging areas such as Bio Data Analytics, Life Sciences-driven translational biology, and data-driven biotechnology. The Department also encourages experiential learning through projects, internships, research exposure, and innovation-driven activities, ensuring students develop critical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and industry-relevant skills in accordance with NEP objectives. Vision & Mission Vision To be a centre of excellence in education and research in Biotechnology to address the global challenges. Mission M1: To offer industry relevant curriculum and research through industry collaborations. M2: To continuously upgrade the infrastructure to develop the facilities for training and research. M3: To provide a good learning environment to help students imbibe professional ethics, communication skills, team spirit and societal commitment. Infrastructure & Facilities The Department is equipped with cutting-edge computing infrastructure : High performance GPU Servers (GPX 5 series) GPU-enabled work stations High Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) (Preparative& Analytical) RT-PCR UV Spectrophotometer 20 ltrs Fermenter Faculty Faculties from varied background including Biochemistry, Microbiology, Bioprocess Engineering, Bimolecular Simulations, Green Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Genomics, Proteomics, and Nanobiotechnology. M.S. Engineering (Research) A research-focused postgraduate program designed to develop advanced analytical and innovation skills. Ph.D. Research opportunities in OMICS Technologies, Biomolecular Simulations and Dynamics, Bioprocess Engineering, Nanomedicine, Applied Microbial Biotechnology, and Biopolymer Technology. Syllabus 1st Year (Sem I & II) 2nd Year (Sem III & IV) 3rd Year (Sem V & VI) 4th Year (Sem VII & VIII) Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) Graduates from Biotechnology will achieve the following Program Educational Objectives within few years of graduation: The graduates of the program are practicing engineering profession in IT sectors (IT system engineers, data analyst and computer programmer), and BT sectors (clinical data coordinator, clinical research associate, Quality controller and Quality assurance analyst, Molecular biologist and Business development executive) The graduates of the program are engaged in higher studies leading to professional degree in specific domain such as biological sciences, computational biology and also engaged in life-long learning. The graduates of the program practice profession with high ethical and moral values and have developed good communication skills and leadership qualities while working as a member of the team or as a team leader. Program Outcomes (POs) Graduates will be able to: Engineering Knowledge: Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization respectively to develop to the solution of complex engineering problems. Problem Analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions with consideration for sustainable development. Design/Development of Solutions: Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design/develop systems/components/processes to meet identified needs with consideration for the public health and safety, whole-life cost, net zero carbon, culture, society and environment as required. Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems: Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research-based knowledge including design of experiments, modelling, analysis & interpretation of data to provide valid conclusions. Engineering Tool Usage: Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering & IT tools, including prediction and modelling recognizing their limitations to solve complex engineering problems. The Engineer and The World: Analyze and evaluate societal and environmental aspects while solving complex engineering problems for its impact on sustainability with reference to economy, health, safety, legal framework, culture and environment. Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, human values, diversity and inclusion; adhere to national & international laws Individual and Collaborative Team work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse/multi-disciplinary teams. Communication: Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations considering cultural, language, and learning differences. Project Management and Finance: Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, and to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments. Life-Long Learning: Recognize the need for and have the preparation and ability for i) independent and life-long learning ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies and iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change Program Specific Objectives (PSOs) Students will be able PSO1: To conduct the Upstream and Downstream experiments to produce, optimize, separate, purify and characterize biological compounds. PSO2: To solve advanced biological problems with the technical skills of Bioinformatics, Biomolecular simulation, Proteomics and Genomics using computational techniques. pages.title: Best Engineering college in Bangalore for Chemical Engineering
pages.text: Department of Chemical Engineering Overview The Department of Chemical Engineering at SIT stands out to be the First Private Engineering College in Karnataka to offer B.E. in Chemical Engineering. The Department was established in the year 1974 with the undergraduate Chemical Engineering program and with time, the department has transformed itself into one of high repute offering doctoral programs. B.E. Chemical Engineering Programme has been accredited by National Board of Accreditation (NBA), New Delhi, wide their file no.: 25-113-2010-NBA, dated 04-112019, for a period of three years, from the academic year 2019-20 to 2021-2022, up to 30-06-2022. The department has over the years been working towards achieving its Vision and Mission which are in tune with the Institute’s Vision and Mission and also a well laid-out quality policy being adopted in all its activities. Department Milestones A legacy of firsts — from Karnataka’s early Chemical Engineering programmes to international research collaborations. Years of Excellence 0 + Research funding 0 Cr+ Industry & Intl. MoUs 0 + Center of Excellence 0 Foundations & firsts 1974 First Chemical Engineering department to start B.E. in Karnataka after NITK. 1982 First department to establish its own dedicated departmental library. 1992 First department to start M.Tech in Chemical Engineering under Bangalore University. 1994 First department to launch the National Level Chemical Engineering Students Seminar ChESS. 1994 First department to establish a Research Centre for awarding PhDs. Recognition & growth 2008 First Chemical Engineering department to receive autonomous status. 2014 First department to apply for patents 2016 First department to establish a Biomedical Research Lab — Bio-INvENT Lab — with international collaborations, funded by Rs. 50 lakhs from SSES Tumkur. 2017 First Chemical Engineering department to receive Rs. 1 Crore from Karnataka Govt. and SSES Tumkur to set up a Water & Wastewater Management Cell. Research excellence & global reach 2018 – 2022 Department gets a funding of Rs. 1.21 crores from various Government agencies and private companies to carry out research (VGST, SERB, BRNS, DST-Lockheed Martin-Tata Trusts, ARVO - USA, Indo French Center) 2021 – 2022 Department generates a revenue of more than Rs. 6 Lakhs from consultancy projects and technical (analytical) services to multiple industries and institutions 2021 Department starts the first of its kind Risk Management Center of Excellence (RMCoE) in partnership with DNV-GL India (Norwegian Company) and IIChE 2022 Department hosts Prof. William Krantz (University of Colorado, USA) as the Fulbright Specialist for one month. The program was fully funded by the US-India Educational Foundation (USIEF) and the Fulbright Foundation, USA 2023 Department gets a research funding of Rs. 3.36 crores from DBT (Govt. of India) to set up a network research center to perform cutting edge research in the area of cancer immunotherapy, in collaboration with NIMHANS, Bengaluru New horizons 2024 Established a world-class biomedical research Center of Excellence with funding from Govt. of India and SSES, Tumkur in collaboration with NIMHANS and IITs 2025 Department signs an MoU with AKXA Tech Pvt. Ltd., Belagavi to facilitate students internships, projects and placements in the area of process control data analytics 2025 Department signs an MoU with Cutis Medi Apparels LLC and Cutis Academy of Cutaneous Sciences <(a subsidiary of Cutis Hospital), Bengaluru to develop innovative skin healthcare products 2025 Department signs an MoU with Public Health Literacy, USA and Harvard Medical School, USA to work in the area of public health focused on environmental factors on community health 2025 Department gets a research & consultancy grant of Rs. 10 lakhs from Cutis Medi Apparel LLC, Bengaluru to develop Ag-TiO2 blended antimicrobial and UV protective clothing 2026 Department gets a research & consultancy grant of Rs. 34 lakhs from Cutis Academy of Cutaneous Sciences, Bengaluru to develop cell therapy protocols for Indian Vitiligo patients Vision & Mission Vision “ To be an internationally renowned department for Chemical Engineering education and research, meeting the aspirations of society “ Mission M1 : To impart quality education in Chemical Engineering at all levels. M2: To foster cutting edge research and development in Chemical Engineering M3: To produce responsible and ethical engineers to serve society Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) A sound knowledge of chemical engineering to pursue a successful professional career A spirit of inquiry and urge to pursue research in chemical engineering and thrust areas. High ethical values and be socially responsible in discharging their duties. Knowledge of the latest developments in their field of activity and commit themselves to life-long learning Program Outcomes (POs) Engineering Knowledge: Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization as specified in WK1 to WK4 respectively to develop to the solution of complex engineering problems. Problem Analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions with consideration for sustainable development. (WK1 to WK4) Design/Development of Solutions: Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design/develop systems/components/processes to meet identified needs with consideration for the public health and safety, whole-life cost, net zero carbon, culture, society and environment as required. (WK5) Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems: Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research-based knowledge including design of experiments, modelling, analysis & interpretation of data to provide valid conclusions. (WK8). Engineering Tool Usage: Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering & IT tools, including prediction and modelling recognizing their limitations to solve complex engineering problems. (WK2 and WK6) The Engineer and The World: Analyze and evaluate societal and environmental aspects while solving complex engineering problems for its impact on sustainability with reference to economy, health, safety, legal framework, culture and environment. (WK1, WK5, and WK7). Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, human values, diversity and inclusion; adhere to national & international laws. (WK9) Individual and Collaborative Team work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse/multi-disciplinary teams. Communication: Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations considering cultural, language, and learning differences Project Management and Finance: Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, and to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments. Life-Long Learning: Recognize the need for, and have the reparation and ability for: Independent and life-long learning Adaptability to new and emerging technologies and Critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change. (WK8 ). Programme Specific Outcomes (PSOs) Graduates will be able to apply the knowledge of science and transport process for production and separation of chemicals in chemical and allied industries Graduates will be able to analyze processes/equipment taking into consideration, process safety, project engineering, economics and environmental aspects. Graduates will be able to analyze processes using process control, process optimization and integration using modelling/simulation tools for process developmen Graduates will be able to design chemical equipment for a given process Advisory Board Chairman Dr. N Meyyappan Professor & Head Department of Chemical Engineering SIT, Tumakuru – 572 103 Convener Dr. Sudhir H Ranganath Associate Professor Department of Chemical Engineering SIT, Tumakuru – 572 103 Internal Members Dr. G R Suma Assistant Professor Department of Chemical Engineering SIT, Tumakuru – 572 103 External Members Prof. Raju Kumar Gupta Professor, Department of Chemical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur Mr. Prasanna G Joshi Co-Founder and Sales Manager, Aaruni Life Sciences, Bengaluru Mr. Venu R General Manager, Biozeen, Bengaluru Mr. Gururaj D Rudagi Senior Executive Vice President, Reliance Industries, Mumbai Mr. Shridhar Rajappanavar Founder and CEO, Key Sustainability, Bengaluru Mr. Kiran Raviprakash Advanced Data Scientist, Honeywell Technology Solutions, Bengaluru Academic Programs & Syllabus Under Graduate Programmes(UG) B.E. pages.text: Admissions Department of Chemistry Overview The Department of Chemistry is a vibrant and research-driven academic unit, equipped with three well-established laboratories and a dedicated research center that supports advanced scientific exploration and innovation. The research center is well-furnished with state-of-the-art instrumentation including X-Ray Diffractometer (XRD), Spectrofluorimeter, UV-Visible Spectrophotometer, High Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC), Spectrophotometer, Battery Testing Unit, Fourier Transform Infrared Spectrometer (FTIR), Electrochemical Workstation, Atomic Absorption Spectrometer (AAS), Rotoevaporator, Polarimeter, Flash Chromatography System and a Sputtering Unit. These facilities enable high-quality research in diverse emerging areas of chemistry and are extensively utilised for inhouse research and testing services. The faculty members of the department are actively involved in cutting edge research in various fields such as peptide & peptidomimetics, nanomaterials and polymers. The current research is also focused on energy and environmental related issues like batteries, hydrogen production, identification and removal of organic and inorganic pollutants, sensors biosensors and fuel cell applications. The department has successfully secured numerous externally funded research projects, reflecting its growing reputation and contribution to scientific advancement. In addition to academic and research activities, the department also provides consultancy and testing services for external institutions and industries. M2: Carryout research solving societal problems. pages.text: Department of Civil Engineering Admissions Overview The Department of Civil Engineering has been in existence since the inception of SIT in 1963. It has grown into a full-fledged department with specializations in all the major areas of Civil Engineering. The academic programmes offered by the department are B.E. in Civil Engineering, M.Tech (Structural Engineering), M.Tech (Transportation Engineering & Management), M.Sc. Engg (by research), and Ph.D. The departmental academic activities include designing curriculum for the contemporary needs of the civil engineering profession, delivering it through appropriately designed teaching methods at UG and PG levels, and assessing the effectiveness of delivery through examinations, quizzes, etc., along with career counseling for students. Other co-curricular academic activities are designed to fill gaps in the curriculum. These include field visits, participation in workshops, conferences, hackathons, design competitions, ideathons, etc. Students of the Civil Engineering department also participate in extracurricular activities such as sports, social service (NSS), yoga, NCC, etc. In addition to academic activities, the department is involved in research and development work and offers consultancy and technical services to industry and society. With the introduction of PG programs and recognition of the department as a VTU research centre, the focus widened to PG studies and research in addition to UG activities. Faculty members are encouraged to upgrade their qualifications and improve their knowledge base. With SIT becoming an autonomous institution under VTU in 2007, curricula have been continuously updated to meet industry needs. The department has adopted an outcome-based assessment system since 2014. Around 70% of graduating students are placed in industry, while 30% pursue higher studies or entrepreneurship. The alumni of the department are employed in academic institutions, industry, and government organizations across different states of the country and abroad, with many occupying prestigious positions. The department is recognized as one of the best Civil Engineering departments in the state of Karnataka. Program Details Undergraduate Program: Sl. No. Program Name Current Intake 1 B.E. Civil Engineering with and without Honors 60 2 M.Tech Structural Engineering 12 3 M.Tech Transportation Engineering & Management 12 Vision & Mission Vision To become a Premier Civil Engineering Department offering excellent engineering education in design methods and advanced technologies to the students, to pursue research in thrust areas and to offer professional service to the society . Mission The Department is committed to develop competent professionals by offering need based curriculum in Civil Engineering areas, promoting research and innovation to prepare the students for higher study, life-long learning and societal responsibility. The department is also committed to provide good learning environment to develop professional ethics and skills in our students and to provide engineering services to the society. Infrastructure & Facilities The Civil Engineering Department is equipped with modern infrastructure and laboratories: Laboratories : Structural Engineering Laboratory Geotechnical Engineering Laboratory Fluid Mechanics Laboratory Transportation Engineering Laboratory Project & Research Labs : M.Tech and Ph.D. research labs with high-end computing facilities and research equipment. Computer Lab : Equipped with the latest software for 3D modeling, structural analysis, and design. Faculty The department boasts a team of experienced and highly qualified faculty members who are specialized in areas like structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, water resources, and transportation engineering. Faculty members actively engage in research and are involved in industry collaborations. pages.text: Department of Computer Science & Engineering Admissions Overview The Department of Computer Science and Engineering was established in 1986 with an initial intake of 60 students, offering a Bachelor’s degree under Bangalore University. Over the years, the Department has steadily grown in recognition and strength with the present intake of 240. Currently, it offers three autonomous programs affiliated with Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU). In 2003, the Department established a VTU-recognized research center, further enhancing its academic and research capabilities. The Department is supported by a team of highly qualified and experienced faculty, and features well-equipped laboratories catering to undergraduate, postgraduate, and research programs. Renowned for its academic excellence and infrastructure, the Department is one of the top options for CET and COMED-K rank holders, and consistently achieving excellent placement records. Program Details Undergraduate Program: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning) B.E. in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science Duration: 4 Years for all the above 3 branches. Focuses on core areas such as programming, data structures, networking, cloud computing, machine learning, and more. B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering (Evening program for working professionals) Duration: 3 Years. Postgraduate Programs: M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering Advanced study in areas like AI, data science, big data, and cybersecurity. Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering The department also offers Ph.D. programs in various research areas such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, and software engineering. Vision & Mission Vision To nurture young Computer Science Engineers with a unique learning experience blended with spiritual values that promotes holistic development by building a strong teaching and research envirornment that is capable of responding to the challenges of 21 st century. Mission M1: To prepare students for productive careers in industry and academia, through comprehensive Computer Science & Engineering based educational programs which focus on technological competence and ethical values with social commitment. M2: To create research ambience that fosters problem solving skills to cater to the needs of industry and society resulting in scholarly publications in reputed journals and conferences. M3: To collaborate with industry, research organisations and higher schools of learning for applied research exposure and capability to handle consultancy projects along with inculcating innovation and entrepreneurship skills. Infrastructure & Facilities The Department of CSE is well-equipped with fourteen laboratories for undergraduate, postgraduate, and research programs. The Department Laboratory Names are: Aryabhata Computer Centre, Linux Lab, Rohini Computer Centre, Bhaskara Computer Centre, Project Lab, M.Tech Lab, Research Lab, Abdul Kalam Lab, Kalpana Chawla Lab, Brahmagupta Lab, Param Lab, Airavat Lab, E-Learning Lab and Shakuntala Devi Lab. All the labs are furnished with high-performance desktop computers, uninterrupted power supply (UPS), and high-speed Internet connectivity to support development and deployment tasks. Each lab is configured with the latest software tools, compilers, IDEs, virtualization platforms, and simulation tools aligned with the curriculum and research needs. The Department is equipped with two high-performance NVIDIA L40 GPUs. These state-of-the-art GPUs significantly enhance the department’s computational capabilities, enabling advanced research in areas such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, and scientific computing. The facility supports both faculty-led research and student projects, providing a robust platform for experimentation, model training, and real-time simulation. With this infrastructure, students gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge hardware, fostering innovation and preparing them for future challenges in high-performance computing and AI-driven technologies The laboratories are designed to facilitate hands-on learning, project development, innovation, and experimentation. Specialized labs for AI, machine learning, deep learning, IoT, Bigdata, full stack development, cybersecurity, HPC are equipped for open-source development, parallel computing, edge computing, and to solve real world applications. The Project Lab and Research Labs support mini-projects, final-year projects, and faculty-led research work. Periodic hardware and software upgrades ensure that the labs stay relevant to emerging technologies such as AI/ML, cybersecurity, cloud computing, full-stack development, and DevOps. The department also facilitates 24×7 lab access for research scholars and students working on industry-sponsored and consultancy projects. Faculty The department has a highly qualified and experienced faculty with expertise in areas such as software engineering, artificial intelligence, data science, cybersecurity, and more. Faculty members actively engage in research and collaborate with industry partners to stay ahead of emerging technological trends. pages.text: Department of Electrical & Electronics Engineering Admissions Overview The Department of Electrical & Electronics Engineering at Siddaganga Institute of Technology (SIT) has been a key pillar of the institute since its establishment. Over the years, the department has grown into a center of excellence in electrical engineering, power systems, power electronics, composits for electrical applications, electric vehicles and embedded systems, providing students with a strong theoretical foundation and hands-on practical exposure. The department is recognized for its quality education, research contributions, and industry collaborations. Program Details Undergraduate Program: B.E. in Electrical & Electronics Engineering Duration: 4 Years Focuses on core areas such as electrical circuits, power systems, control systems, embedded systems, power electronics, and renewable energy technologies. Ph.D. The department also offers Ph.D. programs in various research areas such as power systems, power electronics, electric vehicles & drives, smart grid, composits for electrical & electronics applications. Vision & Mission Vision To be the premier center for education and research in Electrical and Electronics Engineering and to produce globally competent engineers with ethical values. Mission M1: Develop as a center of Excellence for Electrical and Electronics Engineering education by providing the state-of –the-art infrastructure, industry relevant curriculum and effective teaching learning process. M2: Contribute to the development of nation by pursuing research and development in the thrust areas of Electrical and Electronics Engineering such as Power Systems, Electrical Machines, Power Electronics and Renewable Energy Systems. M3: Enable graduates to be professionally competent with strong ethical values. Infrastructure & Facilities The Electrical & Electronics Engineering Department is equipped with state-of-the-art laboratories and research facilities: Laboratories: Power Electronics & Drives Lab – Focused on motor drives, inverters, and energy-efficient control systems. High Voltage & Insulation Lab – Equipped for testing electrical insulation and high-voltage equipment. Electrical Machines Lab – Provides training in motors, generators, and transformers. Research Labs: Renewable Energy Research Lab – Works on solar, wind, and hybrid power generation systems. Composites Lab – Focuses on electrical fabrication of nano composites and thermal characterization of fabricated nano composites. Faculty The department has highly qualified and experienced faculty members specializing in power systems, electrical machines, control systems, IoT, and embedded systems. Faculty members actively engage in research, consultancy projects, and industrial collaborations. pages.text: Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering Admissions Overview B.E. degree program in Telecommunication Engineering at SIT commenced in the academic year 2000-01 and it has been renamed as Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering from the year 2019-20. The department started with an intake of 60 (60 + 6 lateral) students for UG programme, B.E., in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering. The department has also recognized as research center by the VTU from 2011. Currently, 6 research scholars are pursuing their Ph.D. The department is functioning with 13 teaching faculty members including 2 Professors, 3 Associate Professors, 8 Assistant Professors and 6 technical support staff members. The department has 13 Ph.D. (IITKGP-1, IITG-1, IISC-5, NITK-4, IITHYD-1, and VTU-1). Department has accredited four times by National Board of Accreditation (NBA) in the year 2007, 2013, 2020 and 2023 for three years, valid till June-2026. The department has well-equipped laboratories in the areas of Communication, Signal Processing, VHDL, Microprocessors, etc. The graduates from the department are well placed in India and abroad. Few of them have pursued higher studies both in India and abroad. The students of the department have bagged three VTU ranks from 2000 – 2007. Program Details Undergraduate Program: B.E. in Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, 4-years Program provides students with a strong foundation in communication systems, embedded systems, signal processing, VLSI design, and networking, prepare them for careers in telecommunications, semiconductor industries, embedded technology and allied areas. A specialized program that enhances expertise in cutting-edge areas such as wireless communication, IoT, digital signal processing, embedded systems, and RF & microwave engineering. Ph.D. Research opportunities in advanced areas like 5G/6G communication, AI in telecommunications, , VLSI & semiconductor technologies, Image Processing, Optical Communication, Antenna Design, Wireless Communication, satellite communication and next-generation networking. Vision & Mission Vision To become center of excellence in Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering and empower graduates to take up global challenges in emerging areas to harness technological competence while harmoniously blending with spiritual pursuits. Mission M1: To provide best learning experience for students through excellent curriculum, industry collaboration and innovative teaching learning processes. engineering problems. M2: To create good academic ambience for faculty and students by establishing high-quality R & D labs leading to quality research in Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering and allied disciplines. M3: To prepare graduates with technological competence, necessary professional skills and ethics. Infrastructure & Facilities The Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering department is equipped with cutting-edge facilities to support research and learning: Innovation Labs: Dedicated spaces for research in 5G technology, IoT, VLSI design, and embedded systems software used Keil Microvision -4, Xilinx 14.7 High-Tech Electronics Labs: Equipped with state-of-the-art hardware and software tools for signal & image processing, microcontrollers, and RF microwave communication. Advanced Software Environments: Provides access to specialized platforms for MATLAB, Simulink, FPGA design, AWR Environment design, IE3D Simulation Tool, NI LabView Simulation Tool and Digilent Waveform Tool. Telecommunication & Networking Facilities: Hands-on labs for wireless communication, optical fibre networks, satellite communication, CISCO-CCNA, Data Structure & Algorithm certifications. IoT & Embedded Systems Labs: Real-world exposure to sensor networks, automation, and microprocessor-based system design. Remote Access & Virtual Labs: Enables students to conduct simulations and hardware experiments remotely, ensuring flexible learning opportunities. Faculty The department has a team of highly qualified and experienced faculty members specializing in areas such as wireless communication, signal processing, VLSI design, embedded systems, and optical fiber technology. Faculty members actively engage in research, industry collaborations, and consultancy projects. (WK8). (WK9) PO8 : Individual and Collaborative Team work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse/multi-disciplinary teams. PO10 : Project Management and Finance: Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, and to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments. PSO2: The ability to identify problems in the areas of communication and embedded systems and provide efficient solutions using modern tools/algorithm individually or working in a team (Problem solving Skills). pages.text: Department of Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering Admissions Overview Department of Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering was established in 1979 offering BE degree course in Instrumentation Technology. Later the department was renamed as Department of Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering in the year 2014. The department is offering UG and PG programs. The department is recognized as research centre by VTU to offer Ph.D and MSc (Engg) since 2006. There is provision for working professionals to pursue PG in VLSI Design and Embedded systems. The UG program is accredited twice under TIER-I by NBA. The department has experienced and qualified faculty members. 85% of the faculty members are Ph.D holders. Faculty members are actively pursuing research in the areas of Materials, Thin film sensors, Bio-medical signal processing and VLSI design. the department has state of the art thin film laboratory for research in thin films. Faculty members are pursuing research projects funded by national and state funding bodies such as GTRE, DST-FIST, VGST and Secure Machines. Seven Ph.Ds are produced from the research centre. Program Details UG program in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering with an intake of 60 students. PG program in VLSI Design and Embedded Systems with an intake of 12 students. Ph.D. program in Electrical and Electronics Engineering Sciences. Vision & Mission Vision To become a premier Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering Department by imparting quality education in the fields of electronics, instrumentation and cutting edge technologies developing competence to meet industrial norms and to pursue research and innovation contributing to socioeconomic development. Mission The Department is committed to M1: Develop competent professionals by offering industry aligned curriculum in Electronics, Instrumentation and VLSI and embedded systems along with an exposure to cutting edge technologies by providing best in class learning , promoting interdisciplinary research and innovation catering to industrial and societal needs. M2: Encourage and prepare students for higher studies to promote lifelong learning. M3: Imbibe professional ethics and skills in students to provide engineering service to the society. M4: Collaborate with industries to inculcate industry readiness, creativity, managerial competence, experiential learning and entrepreneurship skills. pages.text: Department of Industrial Engineering & Management Admissions Overview The Department of Industrial Engineering and Management (IEM) was started in the year 1986 and has established itself as a center of excellence in education, research, and industry collaboration. With a legacy of academic rigor and innovation, the department focuses on developing future-ready engineers equipped with a unique blend of technical expertise and managerial acumen. All faculty members in the department hold Ph.D. degrees and are actively engaged in cutting-edge research across diverse domains such as Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Science, and Management. Their research output contributes to both academic advancement and industrial problem-solving, enriching the learning experience of students. The department takes pride in its strong alumni network of over 1700 graduates, many of whom have made significant contributions in academia, industry, entrepreneurship, and public service across the globe. Their accomplishments stand as a testament to the quality of education and mentorship provided. With a curriculum designed to meet industry needs and supported by hands-on learning, the department maintains an impressive track record of student placements across top-tier companies in manufacturing, consulting, IT, analytics, and service sectors. The IEM department remains committed to nurturing professionals who can lead in dynamic environments, innovate across processes, and contribute meaningfully to organizations and society. Program Details The department started in the year 1986 has UG program, B.E in Industrial Engineering and Management and has an intake of 60. The UG program has been accredited by NBA for 4th cycle and is valid through 01-07-2025. The department has VTU approved research center started in the year 2011 and offers PG program M.Sc. Engineering by research and Ph.D. Till now, 7 research scholars have been awarded Ph.D. and 2 research scholars have been awarded M.Sc. Engineering by research from the research center. 6 research scholars are pursuing Ph.D. Vision & Mission Vision To be a distinguished Centre for the dissemination of knowledge, promoting research, providing consultancy to societal requirements in the field of Industrial Engineering and Management. Mission M1: To practice the philosophy of learning-teaching-learning and adopt the state of the art pedagogical tools for the effective dissemination of knowledge. M2: To collaborate with academic institutions, industry and research organizations to promote research in emerging areas and consultancy to provide sustainable solutions to societal requirements. M3: To impart training for the overall development of students and inculcate spiritual values. It has eminent faculties with experimce and expertise in specialized areas of Finance, Marketing, Human Resource, Business Analytics and General Management. The Department has active MoUs with Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX, Mumbai) and Infinite Sum Modelling USA. VTU granted autonomous status to the MBA Programme in the year 2008 and it is a recognized Research Centre of VTU offering Ph.D programme. pages.text: Department of Master of Computer Applications Admissions Overview The Department of Master of Computer Applications (MCA) at Siddaganga Educational Society is committed to providing quality education, research opportunities, and industry-oriented training in the field of computer applications. The programme, autonomous since 2008, is affiliated with Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi, and approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi. In 2011, VTU Recognized MCA research center which promotes research activities, innovation, and advanced studies in the field of computer applications. The department equipped with state-of-the-art laboratories and modern computing facilities, the programme emphasizes industry-oriented education and practical learning. The department strengthens industry interaction through collaborative teaching, adjunct faculty, industry-specific electives, expert talks, and skill-development programs that prepare students for real-world challenges. Several student-centric initiatives foster innovation, collaboration, and professional growth. These include the technical fest “Zerone,” the coding club “Pidepippers,” the departmental newsletter “InfoVista,” and the “Buddy Program,” which provides alumni-supported mentoring. In addition, specialized training in technical and communication skills helps students to enhance their employability and professional competence. With a strong focus on hands-on learning, continuous curriculum updates, and industry–academia collaboration, the programme consistently achieves excellent outcomes, with nearly 95% of eligible students securing placements annually. This reflects the department’s commitment to academic excellence, research, innovation, and preparing graduates to thrive in the evolving digital era. Program Details The MCA program at Siddaganga Institute of Technology is a 2 year full time postgraduate course offering strong foundations in programming, software development, databases, networking, and system administration. The program admits 60 students annually and requires a bachelor’s degree with Mathematics or related subjects, with 50% marks (45% for reserved categories). Admission is based on PGCET or KMAT entrance exams. Students receive strong industry exposure through internships, projects, and practical training, supported by experienced faculty and well-equipped laboratories Vision & Mission Vision “To effectively mould, quality and responsible computer professionals, with a service mindset and spirituality, for nurturing the global technological competence.” Mission M1: To develop computer professionals with technical proficiency, soft skills, ethical values, and a service-oriented mindset M2: To foster research, innovation, and problem-solving skills catering to the needs of industry, academia, and society. M3: To promote entrepreneurship and continuous adaptability to emerging technologies. pages.title: Mathematics - Siddaganga Institute of Technology
pages.text: Department of Mathematics Admissions Overview The department of Mathematics came into existence along with S.I.T in 1963. Right from its inception the department has striven to set high standards of teaching. The department has succeeded in this endeavor over the years. The department of Mathematics offers programs for both graduate and post graduate students, by providing the foundation in mathematics that is crucial to the education of engineering students. At present the department has 13 committed teaching faculty members, among them 10 are with doctorial degree, 02 of them are pursuing for Ph. D degree and one member on its non-teaching staff. The department continuously reviews and monitors the curriculum of its academic programs. In the coming decade, apart from strengthening the existing areas, the department intends to develop areas related to mathematical aspects of scientific computing in all its manifestations. The efforts in these directions will lead to greater collaboration with other disciplines of the Institute at a level higher than at present. Short Range Goals To achieve excellent results in examinations, to create awareness among students in recent trends in mathematics by organizing quizzes and Olympiads, to take up sponsored projects from funding agencies such as VTU, AICTE & DST and to have more interdisciplinary interaction to pursue applied research. Long Range Goals The department has a long range goal of getting recognition as a leading department in curriculum development and professional activities at the regional and national level. Program Details The department of Mathematics has a research center under VTU. The Mathematics R&D center so far produced 15 Ph.D. scholars. Currently 05 Scholars are pursuing their doctoral degree. Active research is being pursued in the areas of Fluid dynamics, Magneto Hydrodynamics, Graph Theory, Fuzzy Topology, Soft Topology, Finite Element methods, Natural convection problems, Heat Mass transfer, Finite difference Method, Hydrodynamic lubrication, Complex Analysis, Differential Geometry, and Manifolds. Faculty members in the department collaborate with other research groups in the college. Vision & Mission Vision Mathematics being the fundamental subject that provide the foundation for all Engineering subjects, we all have a task to do the best, nothing less. Mission To provide every under graduate and post graduate student of SIT, the required mathematical knowledge for their professional career and further study in engineering. Infrastructure & Facilities The Mathematics Department is equipped with modern resources to support both teaching and research: Research Center – Dedicated space for Ph.D. scholars and faculty research, Equipped with MAT Lab for computational mathematics & Research. Library & Digital Resources – Access to research journals, e-books, and mathematical databases. Faculty The department comprises highly qualified and experienced faculty members specializing in diverse fields such as algebra, mathematical modeling, computational mathematics, and statistics. Faculty members actively engage in research, interdisciplinary projects, and international collaborations. pages.text: Department of Mechanical Engineering Admissions Overview The Department of Mechanical Engineering, established in 1963, offers UG and Ph.D. programs under VTU with an intake of 120 students. Accredited four times by NBA, it has highly qualified faculty, modern labs, and strong industry collaborations. Faculty have completed projects worth ₹390 lakhs and published over 390 research papers, books, and chapters. With MOUs across industries, students gain exposure through internships, industrial visits, and expert talks. The curriculum is designed with input from industry and academia, ensuring excellent placement opportunities in both core and IT sectors Program Details Under Graduate Programme: B.E., Mechanical Engineering Intake: 120 Duration: 4 years Research Programme: M.Sc. in Engineering by Research Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering Vision & Mission Vision To be one of the Premier Centre for technical education and applied Research in Mechanical Engineering and to bring out globally acclaimed competent engineers with innovative ideas and ethical values to fulfil the societal needs Mission M1- Develop as a Centre of Excellence in Mechanical Engineering by Facilitating the state-of-the-art infrastructure, industry relevant curriculum and effective skill oriented teaching-learning -teaching process. M2- Contribute to the development of Nation by preparing the younger generation to pursue research and development in the thrust areas of mechanical engineering such as thermal power engineering, Manufacturing engineering, Material science engineering, Mechanical Design, Product design and Management. M3- To Prepare mechanical engineering graduates to be professionally competent with strong entrepreneurial, ethical and spiritual values to fulfil societal requirements Infrastructure & Facilities The department has adequate lab facilities equipped with latest laboratory equipment which caters the needs of Mechanical Engineering students for their regular laboratory work, Mini Projects, Major Projects and also for research activities. 1. Bio Energy Research, Information and Demonstration Centre (BRIDC) District Biofuel Research and Information Centre, Mechanical Engineering Department was inaugurated by Dr. Sri Sri Sri Shivakumara Swamiji on 10th August 2011. District Biofuel Information and Demonstration Centre is a funded project by Karnataka State Bioenergy Development Board (KSBDB) managed by Ministry of Rural Development and Panchayat Raj. Biofuel I & D Centre is creating awareness by conducting training programme for the development and maintenance of Non-Edible oil seed plants. KSBDB is funding to conduct 25 awareness programmes every year. Farmers, NGOs and rural school children are educated about the importance of the Non-Edible oil seed plants. Farmers are supported to grow the non-edible seed plants on the bunds and barren land by utilising the programmes like Baradu Bangara and Suvarnabhoomi schemes. Information and Demonstration Centre, Siddaganga Institute of Technology is producing 50 litres of Biodiesel per day. Produced biodiesel is utilised in college DC generators and vehicles and its performance is studied regularly. This programme is supporting UG, PG and PhD scholars for doing research work. Students and research scholars have published research papers on development and characterization of biodiesel from different species. Karnataka State Council for Science and Technology is funding biofuel projects regularly under SPP programme. This programme is carried out in collaboration with Mechanical, Chemical, Biotechnology and Chemistry Departments. I & D Centre is also supporting KSRTC, IIT Madras, Krishi Vignana Kendra and other Engineering colleges in Karnataka State for carrying out research projects. (WK8). (WK1, WK5, and WK7). PO7 : Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, human values, diversity and inclusion; adhere to national & international laws. (WK9) PO8 : Individual and Collaborative Team work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse/multi-disciplinary teams. pages.text: Department of Physics Admissions Overview The Department of Physics was established in 1963. With continuous infrastructure development since 1963, today the department is equipped with two well established Engineering Physics Labs catering to the needs of First year B.E. autonomous curriculum. At present the department has three teaching faculties among them two are with doctorate degree. In addition to them there are two supporting staffs to assist the departmental activities. The Department of Physics has been recognized as the Research Center by VTU, Belgaum since 2006. The research center is actively involved in the area of quantum computing, spectroscopy, crystallography, nanocomposites, radiation physics, materials science and allied domain. Eight students have received PhD from the center and seven students are currently pursuing their PhD. Five research projects funded by VGST, Government of Karnataka and Two projects funded by DST – Government of India were completed. Two projects sanctioned by DST(WOS-A) and UGC-DAE CSR are ongoing in the department. The department has published more than 150 papers in international/national journals and conferences Program Details I/II Semester UG: Physics for Sustainable Structural Systems (For Civil Stream). Quantum Physics and Applications (For CSE/ISE/AIML/BT Branches). Physics of Materials (For ME/IEM/CH Branches). Quantum Physics and Electronics Sensors (For EC/EI/ET Branches). Electrical Engineering Materials (For EE Branch). Ph.D. Programme Vision & Mission Vision To promote and popularize the potentials of basic Physics in interdisciplinary engineering domains leading to societal and technological welfare. Mission To promote the knowledge of Applied Physics among the students so that they can apply it in the thrust areas of Engineering and Technology. pages.text: Research Focus Areas SIT nurtures a dynamic and expanding range of specialized research clusters dedicated to innovation and academic excellence. 1 Materials Science 2 Signal Processing, Speech Processing, Image Processing, Networking, Communication & Microelectronics 3 Signal Processing, Speech Processing, Image Processing, Networking, Communication & Microelectronics 4 Thin Films, Devices and Power Electronics 5 Biomedical Engineering and Novel Separation Processes 6 Finance, Marketing, Operations, Business Analytics & Entrepreneurship 7 Urban Design, Landscape Architecture, Digital Architecture & Sustainable Design 8 Operations Research, Supply Chain Management, Lean Manufacturing & Industrial Automation 9 Power Systems, Electrical Machines, Control Systems, IoT & Embedded Systems 10 Algebra, Mathematical Modeling, Computational Mathematics & Statistics Centers of Excellence State-of-the-art research centers established in partnership with leading organizations Siddaganga Institute of Technology (SIT), Tumakuru, houses seven specialized Centers of Excellence (CoEs) that drive cutting-edge research and innovation across diverse domains. The Bio-INvENT Lab, established with DBT funding, focuses on biomedical research at the intersection of biology, engineering, and nanotechnology, including cancer biology, 3D bioprinting, and nanomedicine. The Nanotechnology CoE (CARN) advances research in nanomaterials, nanoelectronics, nanomedicine, and renewable energy to address national challenges. The MNC TE CARE (M N Channabasappa Centre for Transformative Engineering) promotes sustainable polymer science, additive manufacturing, and circular material strategies. The Chemistry Research Centre conducts research in materials chemistry, energy storage, catalysis, environmental remediation, and nanotechnology. The Thin Films Lab and 5G Use Case Lab further extend SIT’s research capabilities in electronics and next-generation communication technologies. The Automation & Robotics Lab supports innovation in intelligent systems and industrial automation. Together, these CoEs are supported by significant government funding from agencies such as DBT, DST-SERB, ISRO, and VGST, reflecting SIT’s strong research ecosystem. They foster interdisciplinary collaboration, industry consultancy, and hands-on training for students and researchers. pages.text: Companies 0 + Placement Rate 0 % Highest Package 0 LPA Training Integrated 0 Sems The Department of Training and Placements at SIT, Tumakuru is more than just a recruitment hub; it is a bridge between academic excellence and professional success. We are dedicated to guiding our students toward rewarding career opportunities by fostering a robust ecosystem of industry-institution partnerships. Under the divine blessings of His Holiness Padma Bhushan, Karnataka Ratna Dr. Sree Sree Shivakumara Swamigalu, SIT has emerged as a premier destination for top-tier talent from across India and abroad. Our Holistic Approach to Employability We believe that successful placements are the result of a comprehensive developmental journey. We don’t just prepare students for a job; we shape future-ready graduates through: Industry Engagement: Regular guest lectures, industrial visits, and employer roadshows. Rigorous Internships: Gaining hands-on experience in real-world professional environments. Curriculum Alignment: Ensuring our academic offerings meet the evolving demands of the global market. Professional Grooming: Intensive Pre-Placement Training (PPT) focusing on soft skills, aptitude, and interview readiness. Vision “To be a global catalyst in transforming students into industry-ready professionals and architects of the future economy.” Mission To empower students with strong personalities, industry knowledge, and practical skills, ultimately leading to successful placements in top companies. Short Range Goals Actively reach out to industries and invite them for campus recruitment. Prepare students for job interviews through regular aptitude tests, group discussions, and mock interviews, while providing insights into the industrial landscape and their role as engineers. Foster collaborative relationships between the institute and industry, facilitating knowledge exchange, expert visits, and technical discussions. Offer tailored vocational training to students based on their individual strengths and interests. Assist academic departments in arranging industry-based projects to provide students with hands-on experience in solving real-world problems. Long Range Goals Become a leading placement institution, attracting top multinational companies to recruit our students. Establish a premier HR development center to enhance students’ skills in various areas, such as work ethic, integrity, communication, problem-solving, and global industry trends. Collaborate with industries to provide students with valuable vocational training and project opportunities, while also actively contributing to the overall improvement of the academic environment.
